meta_description:
9,704 likes, 130 comments - kayla_itsines on October 27, 2026: "House things 😍
We are at a 3-4 week countdown with our Gold Coast home renovation and it’s sooooo exciting!! 

Please direct all your questions about stone, tiles, joinery, paint colours and wood selections to @honghenwood HAHAHAHAAAA 🤣 No... don’t do that. I can literally hear her overstimulated voice “KAYLA DO NOT, I can’t do social media right now I’m so BUSYYYY” all the way from Noosa 🤣🤣 

No I PROMISE I’ll make a list of everything for you guys. Let me know what you want the details of and I’ll create a FAQ because I know so many people love pulling small things here and there for inspiration. 

We actually used the things that we love from both our previous Adelaide houses and then a brand new stone which is VERY out there… but we love it 😍😍 

Interior designer: @honghenwood 
Builder: @dbbuild (we used the same builders that built the ORIGINAL house that was here) 

Right now the walls all look green because of the green protectant on the flooring, so ignore that. Other than that, these are the little things I love. More to come :) 

I’ll come back with that list !!".
